title: FM27 Mods — Real Name Fix, Facepacks & Compatibility
description: FM27 mods checked 4 November 2026: Real Name Fix V2, named face, logo and 2D kit resources, their stated compatibility limits, and install guidance.
meta: Updated 4 November 2026 · Author-reported compatibility; this site has not tested the downloads.
body:
FM27 mods checked 4 November 2026: choose a real-name fix, player facepack, logo pack or 2D kitpack from the specific resource pages below. Each entry states the publisher's compatibility claim and any unresolved platform instructions. The free Preview ended on 3 November at 18:00 GMT; paid Preview access continues until the scheduled 10 November release.

Named resources and what their pages establish

TypeResource and version shownCompatibility and limits shown by the source
Real namessortitoutsi FM27 Real Name Fix V2 · file updated 30 OctoberFor FM27. The author says the included award, city, stadium, competition and Germany national-team fixes are save-game compatible.
Player facessortitoutsi Cut-Out Player Faces Megapack · 2027.00, released 26 OctoberThe resource page labels the download FM27. Its Windows instructions still mention FM26 preferences; its Mac install section says it is awaiting user feedback. Use the pack page for current platform instructions.
LogosTCM27 Logopack by TCMLogos · official page dated 3 NovemberThe creator explicitly identifies FM27 support and supplies Windows and Mac installation paths. Link opens the official resource page for its current download.
2D kitsFranklyFM84’s 2026/27 2D KitpackThe publisher’s page names FM27 and FM26 support, covers 12 nations, and gives separate Windows and macOS paths. The page was checked 4 November; it does not show a numbered pack version.
Skins and interface changesFM27 skins and installation notesCheck the individual FM27 release and whether it replaces game asset bundles.

These are published compatibility claims, not in-game tests by this site. The links lead to the authors' or publishers' resource pages; files are not hosted here. Recheck each page after a game update, especially where the facepack instructions still refer to an older edition.

FM27 Real Name Fix: where it goes

The sortitoutsi fix changes unlicensed award, city, stadium and competition names and addresses Germany’s national-team selection. Its author describes these fixes as save-game compatible; that statement applies to this named V2 fix, not other editor files or database mods. The page lists Windows Steam, Xbox Game Pass and Epic, macOS Steam and Epic, and Steam Deck paths. The examples below show Windows Steam and macOS Steam only; use the author’s matching path for your platform.

  1. Close FM27 and make a backup of the files you will replace.
  2. Open the FM27 installation path for your platform. For Windows Steam, the author lists Steam/steamapps/common/Football Manager 27/shared/data/database/db. For macOS Steam, it ends in Football Manager 27/fm.app/Contents/PlugIns/game_plugin.bundle/Contents/Resources/shared/data/database/db. Custom library locations change the earlier part of the path; use the linked author page for Xbox Game Pass, Epic or Steam Deck.
  3. Read the current V2 instructions. Copy its dbc, edt and lnc folders into each database folder listed on the author page, not only 2700. The page currently lists eight database folders.
  4. Use the package’s replacement method. The author says V2 contains blank files that overwrite the older fake-name files; follow the current page rather than a deletion checklist from an older FM edition.
  5. Check a known affected name in-game. After a game update, return to the author’s page in case the database directories or fix have changed.

These paths belong to the installation directory. A facepack or logo guide may instead use a user-data directory; placing every kind of mod in one generic folder is not a valid install method.

Install TCM27 logos and FranklyFM84 kits

Both publishers use FM27's user-data graphics folder, separate from the Real Name Fix database directory above. Their path examples are:

  • Windows: Documents/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 27/graphics/
  • Mac: /Users/NAME/Library/Application Support/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 27/graphics/
  1. Close the game and extract the selected archive. Create the graphics folder if it is missing; follow the publisher's instructions if you use a custom user-data location.
  2. For TCM27, place the extracted Megapack TCM27 folder directly inside graphics. For FranklyFM84, keep the nation folders directly inside the kitpack's kits folder; avoid nesting an extra kitpack/kits wrapper.
  3. Restart the game and check a club covered by the pack. The kitpack publisher also describes a Reload Skin option under Preferences > Detailed > Audio & Visuals if the kits do not appear.

FM27 logo packs and licensed assets

For pack selection and missing-badge checks, see the FM27 logo-pack guide.

Check what the game already includes first: Sports Interactive confirms official club logos, kits and player photos for the licensed Arkema Première Ligue. A missing badge in Preview is not by itself proof that a graphics pack is broken; some club and player assets still await rights-holder approval.

FM27 facepacks, logos and kits: check one change at a time

Use the selected pack’s installation instructions, preserve its folder structure and configuration files, and check a club or player the pack actually covers. If the graphics do not appear, use the pack author’s FM27-specific cache or refresh guidance. Do not assume an older edition’s menu or folder layout is unchanged.

The kitpack linked here is a 2D pack. Its support statement does not establish that a separate 3D kit or interface mod works with your build.

Before adding editor data or a tool

  • Match the file to FM27 and the game build it supports; an FM26 label is not interchangeable.
  • Check whether a new save is required. The real names fix’s save compatibility is not a rule for unrelated custom databases.
  • Record any transfer update used with a save before comparing player fees or wonderkid profiles.
  • Back up saves and original game files, then install one change before checking the next.

FM27 mods FAQ

Do FM26 graphics work on FM27?

Sortitoutsi's graphics FAQ says its graphic packs work with FM27, but individual installation notes may still refer to earlier editions. The specific TCM27 and FranklyFM84 pages linked above name FM27 support. Check the selected pack's platform instructions; a graphics claim does not cover unrelated database files, skins or tools.

Where do FM27 mods install?

In different places depending on type. The Real Name Fix copies its dbc, edt and lnc folders into the installation directory's database folders. Graphics and interface content follow the pack author's paths, and current FM27 skins replace game asset bundles rather than using a traditional skins folder. Dropping every download into one generic folder is not a valid install method.

Are FM27 mods safe for an existing save?

The Real Name Fix V2 author describes that fix as save-game compatible, but the statement applies to that named fix only. Editor data and custom databases can require a new save. Back up your saves before installing anything, and add one change at a time so a problem is traceable.

Where can I download FM27 mods?

The named pack and author pages are linked in the table above. Download from the maintainer’s page to get its current version and instructions; this site does not rehost files.
